note: CSS hooks the skin's structural rules attach to, and where each one lives in the installed DSH (0.2.1-rc.2). `local` is the CSS-module name; the shipped class is `<hash>_<local>`, so attribute-contains selectors [class*="_<local>"] are stable. Regenerate after a DSH upgrade: node scripts/extract-dsh-tokens.mjs <ui-theme css dir> … and re-check these names against the client bundles.

hooks.usedFor: reading surface: headings rules, links, hr, blockquote, tables, code, lists
fenced code container: hairline + square corners
documented dark-scheme attribute; the skin itself does not need it because tokens carry both modes
the user's own turn: flat block with an ink rail instead of a chat bubble
composer column, used as the ancestor scope for the input rule
composer field: 2px corners instead of the stock soft card
sidebar masthead: hairline under the wordmark
sidebar entries as a ruled list rather than rounded pills
